en.title: MTA Settles Elevator Lawsuit, Boosting NYC Transit Accessibility for Disabled Riders
en.summary: MTA and disability advocates have settled a long-running lawsuit concerning elevator accessibility in New York City transit. The settlement includes commitments to improve elevator maintenance and accessibility features across the subway system. Other highlights include the launch of Yomupochi search service for visually impaired users, GAAD recognition, an AI accessibility survey, and advice on coping with neurodivergent social challenges.

highlights.title: MTA and disability advocates settle long-running elevator accessibility suit
Launch of Yomupochi Search Service
Global Accessibility Awareness Day Recognition
Survey highlights AI's potential to advance accessibility in work and learning
Advice on Coping with Social Challenges for Neurodivergent Individuals

zh-TW.title: MTA 電梯訴訟和解，提升紐約市交通無障礙設施
zh-TW.summary: MTA 與殘障倡議者解決長期電梯無障礙訴訟，同意改善紐約市地鐵電梯的維護與可及性。其他重點包括三一擴建無障礙設施、漢堡王更新視障菜單、家庭捐贈登山輪椅、AI 無障礙潛力調查，以及神經多樣性社交挑戰建議。

en.title: MTA Unveils Accessible Design for New Interborough Express Transit Line
en.summary: The MTA released detailed accessibility features for the Interborough Express transit line, including level boarding and wheelchair spaces. Meanwhile, L'Oréal announced a multi-year accessibility plan, and BlueRock launched a free website accessibility checker, while new AI tools assist welfare counters and Georgetown University faces criticism over printing accessibility gaps.

highlights.title: MTA details Interborough Express accessibility for vehicle design

BlueRock Launches Free Website Accessibility Checker

zh-TW.title: MTA 公布城際特快線無障礙設計，提升殘障乘客出行便利
zh-TW.summary: MTA 發布城際特快線車輛設計細節，強調平台無階上落、輪椅空間及聲音視覺廣播等無障礙設施。同時，L'Oréal 宣布多年無障礙計畫，BlueRock 推出免費網站無障礙檢查工具，以及 AI 福祉傳譯系統協助聽障人士於福利櫃台使用。
